updates.detail.download-progress.description: Update download progress with known total; percent is a fraction from zero to one, formatted as a locale-aware percentage. size is an already localized byte quantity with its unit.

updates.detail.downloaded.description: Update download progress when total size is unknown; size is an already localized byte quantity with its unit.

updates.detail.install-incomplete.defaultMessage: Installationen af opdateringen blev ikke fuldført
updates.detail.install-incomplete.description: Durable result when an installation attempt did not finish; not a successful update.

updates.detail.install-to-finish.defaultMessage: Downloadet; vælg Installér og genstart for at fuldføre opdateringen
updates.detail.install-to-finish.description: Host update is downloaded; automatic installation is unavailable here. Refer to the Install and restart button.

updates.detail.package-channel.description: Manual update detail for package-managed installations; package is an already localized package-type label such as Linux DEB. Use a sentence that works with any package label without assuming its gender.

updates.detail.restarting.defaultMessage: Genstarter snart for at installere opdateringen
updates.detail.restarting.description: Host updater is in its restart notice interval before installing the downloaded update.

updates.detail.up-to-date.defaultMessage: Version {version} er den nyeste kompatible udgivelse.
updates.detail.up-to-date.description: Updater detail after a manual check; version is the currently running compatible product version.

updates.detail.updated.description: Successful desktop update detail; version is the installed product version. Also shown within the last-update outcome.

updates.detail.waiting-for-work.defaultMessage: Downloadet; afspilning, uafsluttet arbejde eller tilsluttede klienter forhindrer genstart
updates.detail.waiting-for-work.description: Host updater has staged an update but playback, unfinished work, or connected clients block restart. Preserve every reason.

updates.detail.waiting-until-away.defaultMessage: Downloadet; venter, til du er væk
updates.detail.waiting-until-away.description: Host update is downloaded, waiting for user inactivity before restarting. Use the locale register consistently.

updates.last-outcome.description: Durable result of the previous desktop update attempt, separate from current check/download status

updates.restart-countdown.defaultMessage: Genstarter om {seconds} sekunder for at installere opdateringen
updates.restart-countdown.description: Nonmodal countdown before an unattended desktop update restart

updates.status.available.description: Update status title; version is the new product version and must remain unchanged.

updates.status.check-failed.description: Update status title when checking for an update failed; technical detail is displayed separately.

updates.status.downloading.description: Update download status title; version is the new product version, not torrent progress.

updates.status.install-failed.description: Update status title when installation failed; technical detail is displayed separately.

updates.status.installing.description: Update installation status title; version is the new product version.

updates.updated-version.description: In-app success notice shown only when the user next interacts with the updated application

video.loading.description: In-app video player: status while the local file opens.

video.open.new.tab.description: In-app video player: button that opens the file in a new browser tab instead.
